messages.author: 1d8f09b6a62540d7
messages.subject: Error : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
parts:
I built a dashboard, which pulls data from hadoop and throws the output based on certain filters.

function(input, output) {
  
  # Filter data based on selections
  output$table <- DT::renderDataTable(DT::datatable({
    dbConn <- odbcConnect(xxxxx)
     Data <- sqlQuery(dbConn,"xxxxx")
    if (input$servicecategory != "All") {
      Data <- Data[Data$servicecategory == input$servicecategory,]
    }
    if (input$brand != "All") {
      Data <- Data[Data$brand == input$brand,]
    }
    if (input$pos != "All") {
      Data <- Data[Data$pos == input$pos,]
    }
     Data
  }))
  
}

How do i handle the error?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Error : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
parts:
1. Can you paste the entire error from the R console? There should be a stack trace.
2. You're loading all of the data from hadoop into memory, and then doing the filtering in memory. Are you sure you want to do that? It would seem to be better to vary the query depending on what the user has selected. You can do this with dplyr (I wouldn't do this by cobbling together a dynamic SQL query string, that's an easy way to introduce security vulnerabilities). I don't know how easy it is to use ODBC with dplyr today (it may be possible using RODBCDBI and dplyr::src_sql), but in the coming weeks RStudio will be introducing much improved ODBC/dplyr support.
